notes.title: Long overdue patch
notes.notes:
Long overdue patch fixing some bugs

[list]
[*] Spears don't collide with player anymore
[*] Field of view can now be adjusted with the mouse wheel
[*] Fixed some occlusion culling issues
[*] Aiming now closes other interact prompts, the game will no longer try and make you interact with things and pick up objects at the same time
[*] Fixed some graphical bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Quick Executable Fix
notes.notes: Some bozo put a space in the executable file's name making steam not recognize it, this will not go unpunished. We apologize sincerely for the inconvenience and have repaired the issue.

notes.title: Groundwork Update
notes.notes:
As I said the games framework has been revised and now uses several new systems

[b][h1]All New Player System[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*]New save system
[*]Multiple save files supported now
[*]All new player model
[*]Customizable payer
[*]Aiming the slingshot works better
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43775317/0e7803ff4c9f84467ae432560e4f0a269eb9ead5.png[/img]

[b][h1]Save Da World[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*]Multiple areas have been revised with more detail
[*]Guards have new AI framework
[*]New sound effects for things that were quiet before
[/list]

[b][h1]Quality of Life? Hah[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*]Game runs much better now
[*]New UI and assets that look less stinky
[*]Texture fixes
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.1 Small Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed spears warping on certain surfaces
Tomba boss fight no longer continues spawning ball droids after death
Tomba boss laser beam no longer stays after death
Occlusion culling tweaked

notes.title: Arms Patch 0.0
notes.notes:
Arms have been tampered with and are now more compliant

-Some quality of life changes

notes.title: Major Update - The Lore Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]MAJOR UPDATE v1.0.0[/b][/h1]

[b]Welcome to the Lore Update, many new additions to All Goblin have been made, increasing the world both in size and in story[/b]

[b]New Lore - New Areas - New Enemies[/b]


[b]New Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] New Areas to explore
[*] KillBot enemy
[*] New easter eggs and secrets
[*] Guards now have dialogue
[*] Health Stations
[*] Damage Increase Upgrade
[*] Ability to interact with previously inanimate creatures
[*] Ability to pray to arms for guidance
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance Improvements
[*] Some glitch fixes
[*] Enemy navigation fixes
[*] UI Improvements
[*] Experience points are clarified lore-wise and no longer non-descript experience
[*] Some scripting has been improved and streamlined - namely health mechanics for enemies
[/list]

[h3][list]
[*] More secrets await in game, for feedback, send an email to problemsgoblin@gmail.com
[/list][/h3]

notes.title: Version 0.5.1 Patch - Audio and Bug Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adding many new sound effects to the game
[*] New boss music for Toomba
[*] Bugs and graphical glitches patched
[*] Enemy AI improvements for guards
[*] Better Damage Scaling for Toomba
[*] Slingshot not firing properly in some cases fixed
[*] Fixed some audio issues with ambience, namely it sounded like dog-water and doesn't sound as dog-water now
[*] Set up building blocks for future major update soon
[/list]
